source_script_contents:
from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,subprocess,sys
baseline=json.loads(Path("docs/acceptance/evidence/m3/candidate-frozen.json").read_text())
paths=set(baseline["sha256"]) | {"integration/http_fetch_contract/upstream_peer.py", "integration/http_fetch_contract/empty_continuation_probe.exs", "integration/http_fetch_contract/pooled_completion_probe.exs"}
result={"head":subprocess.check_output(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"],text=True).strip(),"sha256":{p:hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in sorted(paths)}}
Path(sys.argv[1]).write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2,sort_keys=True)+"\n")
print("Captured",len(paths),"source files",sys.argv[1])
